research_question: After deterministic ontology grounding identifies supported action targets and exact candidate spans, what is the smallest local model that can reliably classify each target's final pragmatic commitment?

project_scope.system_component: supported VRM action perception and pragmatic commitment judgment
project_scope.expected_project_effect: Replace fragile full-frame generation with a grounded cognitive division of labor suitable for future local VRM function calling.

scientific_basis.name: value_agnostic_conversational_semantic_parsing
scientific_basis.design_use: Separate reusable schema structure and grounded values from pragmatic classification.

scientific_basis.name: symbolic_planning_and_code_generation_for_grounded_dialogue
scientific_basis.design_use: Keep symbolic grounding observable and deterministic before execution.

scientific_basis.name: frugal_model_cascade
scientific_basis.design_use: Select the smallest local specialist that satisfies accuracy and latency gates.

scientific_basis.name: expected_value_of_control
scientific_basis.design_use: Allocate one narrow judgment only to action targets actually grounded in the utterance.

feasibility_audit.decision: The supported-target candidate layer is feasible for a commitment-classification experiment. Unsupported-action discovery remains a separately reported open-set task.

input_fields: numbered exact anchor spans for that target
classification_unit.final_commitment_rule: Classify the final status of the target after reading the entire utterance, including corrections and cancellations.
classification_unit.evidence_rule: Choose one index from the supplied exact anchor spans; the model never rewrites evidence text.
classification_unit.no_candidate_rule: If the ontology grounds no supported target, make no classifier call and propose no supported action.

model_selection_rule.eligibility: A condition must pass every development gate.
model_selection_rule.primary_order: Choose the eligible condition with the smallest frozen blob_bytes.
model_selection_rule.tie_breaker: If sizes are equal, choose lower p95 case latency.
model_selection_rule.no_pass_rule: If no model passes, do not create or consume a fresh holdout.

decision_rule: Select the smallest classifier that passes every retired-development gate. Only that frozen model may run on a newly committed holdout. Passing every fresh gate authorizes shadow integration for supported actions only; unsupported-action discovery and physical execution remain disabled.
